summary: This report provides an update on the progress and next steps of the partnership with Evergreen to implement the Lower Don Trail Access, Environment, and Art Master Plan and seeks authority to undertake community consultation on the proposed naming of the network of parks surrounding the Lower Don to the "Wonscotonach Parklands."
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to undertake community consultations on naming the collection of parklands surrounding the Lower Don as the "Wonscotonach Parklands" and to report back to Toronto and East York Community Council with a recommendation based on the criteria and process outlined in the Property Naming Policy.

text: This report provides an update on the progress and next steps of the partnership with Evergreen to implement the Lower Don Trail Access, Environment, and Art Master Plan and seeks authority to undertake community consultation on the proposed naming of the network of parks surrounding the Lower Don to the "Wonscotonach Parklands."

City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council direct the General Manager, Parks, Forestry and Recreation, to undertake community consultations on naming the collection of parklands surrounding the Lower Don as the "Wonscotonach Parklands" and to report back to Toronto and East York Community Council with a recommendation based on the criteria and process outlined in the Property Naming Policy.
